## What's Changed
### New to Path of Building
• Add config for Careful Counterattack by @AdamZ-8113 in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10497
• Show shrine options for The Covetous Dark by @AdamZ-8113 in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10500
• Add support for animate guardian gear buffs by @fabianmaurer in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10545
• Add config for Fleshrend stacks from Pact of Ghorr by @lucaskarsten in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10531
• Add support for Cost Efficiency of Retaliation skills mastery by @PJacek in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10549
• Add support for bricked imbued support gems by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10488
• Upgrade Loadout Management UI by @FenikSRT4 in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/9647
• Update Spectre Library UI by @Blitz54 in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/9816
### User Interface
• Fix ugly Covetous Dark variants by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10499
• Fix tooltips not working when another UI element has focus by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10537
• Fix tree comparison highlighting same mastery selections by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10536
• Add a breakdown for mana/life reservation efficiency by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10534
• Add config for brine charges by @cupkax in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10532
• Add item type icons and (equipped) text to items tab by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10530
• Fix hover on Calcs tab for ES/Ward when there is a global source but 0 from gear by @Blitz54 in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10550
• Add header images for Viscera items by @Blitz54 in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10557
### Fixed Calculations
• Fix Wickerman tree check and Viscera glove/boot bonuses by @juddisjudd in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10484
• Add totem flag to Witchhunter's Pyre by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10487
• Fix inverted negative resistance exceeding the enemy's maximum resistance by @lucaskarsten in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10492
• Fix Waxen Soul shrine buff effect per Life Reserved not applying by @lucaskarsten in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10486
• Fix Arcane Cloak using negative unreserved mana by @eduardomdalmaso in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10517
### Fixed Behaviours
• Fix repeated attacks triggering triggers incorrectly by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10498
• Fix Life Mastery working with The Apostate by @PJacek in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10543
• Fix editing build not triggering compare tab rebuilds by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10535
• Fix some Hide of the Vendigo interactions by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10520
• Fix Mantle of Dreams blocking support parts of skill gems by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10548
### Accuracy Improvements
• Fix missing skill on Greater Chimeral Eye by @Wires77 in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10558
### Fixed Bugs
• Fix invalid trade site query on modified unique title by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10544
• Fix item granted skills permanently modifying skill data by @vaisest in https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/pull/10528
